doc: Reviewed classification of non-REST entry types in apps/*. tests/test_entrypoint_inventory.py fails when an entry type appears or disappears without a matching entry here.

entries.name: _parent.mount
entries.rationale: Composes the apps' own ASGI apps under one server; each mounted app carries its own route policies (route_authz) and operator boundary. The mount adds no route of its own.

entries.name: threading.Thread
entries.rationale: Outcome observer, off unless BILLING_OUTCOME_INTERVAL_S > 0. Its tick only observes due outcomes (a read from Lago plus recording learning); it takes the loop lock non-blocking and never refits or executes. No external write.

entries.name: _shutdown
entries.rationale: Router startup/shutdown: rehydrates parked missions and starts/stops the optional observer above. No request-reachable effect.

entries.name: _startup
entries.rationale: Router startup/shutdown: rehydrates parked missions and starts/stops the optional observer above. No request-reachable effect.

entries.name: threading.Thread
entries.rationale: Runs one already-started, already-SCAN_ALLOWLIST-checked scan profile (nmap or a read-only kubectl query) to completion off the request thread, so scan_start can return a job_id immediately; scan_status/scan_results poll it. The allowlist check happens in server.py before the thread is ever started, not here, so this thread itself performs no new authorization decision.

entries.name: _check_declared_bind
entries.rationale: Startup guard added by audit item P9: it reads the declared bind host and, on a non-loopback bind, refuses to start unless the operator has both authorised the exposure explicitly and configured a credential. It performs no I/O and no edge action - its only effect is to raise and stop the app before the first request is served, so a misconfigured container never binds.

entries.name: threading.Thread
entries.rationale: Detached job started by the public /api/chat route to run an in-app content-generation action chosen by the chat model. It passes no approval marker, so the core stages any consequential action (push_assets); the result lands in an in-memory job table.

entries.name: _start_case_sync
entries.rationale: Starts the case-sync loop at startup. The loop only calls live.sync_cases(), the same idempotent ingestion that used to run inside a GET; it takes no request, decides nothing, executes nothing and every action it creates stays AWAITING_APPROVAL. SENTINEL_SYNC_INTERVAL_S=0 turns it off.

entries.name: _stop_case_sync
entries.rationale: Stops the case-sync loop at shutdown; it has no other effect.

entries.name: threading.Thread
entries.rationale: The case-sync loop thread (daemon). It ingests CrowdSec alerts into cases on a timer so that no read has to. It proposes at most the approval-gated block_ip action a case already carries; it never approves or executes, and a failed tick is retried on the next one.
